services.desc: An exclusive experience! Duration 50-minutes to 4 Hours Seasonal Flowers and foliage (optional): Medium: 2 1/2 gallons of flowers and foliage: $150 Large: 5 gallons of flowers and foliage: $300 About Give your loved one a beautiful send off with compassionate and experienced professionals aboard Kona’s Glassbottom

services.name: Private Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a truly unique sunset cruise aboard the Kona Glassbottom Boat. Rate $1,500 up to 24 people Duration 1.5 Hours About This adventure will start out with a tour along the coast while viewing the reef through the glass bottom windows. An onboard naturalist is there to answer all your questions about the coral reef and its inhabitants. As the sun reaches the horizon and begins to set, focus will move to the sky as we cruise along the coast. Bring your own pupus (appetizers) and beverages to enjoy

services.name: Glass Bottom Reef Tour
services.desc: A Relaxing Glass Bottom Tour Along Kona's Beautiful Coast! Duration 50 minutes About ENJOY a comfortable and relaxing glass bottom boat cruise along Kona's beautiful coastline. DISCOVER spectacular colors of the island's underwater world. SEE unique tropical fish and colorful coral formations. LEARN about Hawaii’s flora and fauna from onboard

services.name: Private Charter (Kailua-Kona Pier Departure)
services.desc: If you want your own exclusive Reef Tour, or want to use our boat for a special occasion, this is the perfect option. Duration 50-minutes About What better way to celebrate a family reunion, wedding, birthday or just the fact that you are in Hawaii, than a cruise along the coast in our glass bottomed boat. Just like our Reef Tour, an onboard naturalist will be there to tell you all about what you are seeing below the waves. If are not looking for a reef tour, and want to use the boat for a wedding or other such event, just let us know. You can bring your own food and drinks to enjoy on board. services.name: 4th of July Fireworks, Sunset & Night Glassbottom
services.desc: Celebrate Fourth of July aboard the Kona Glassbottom boat! Duration 1 Hour About Watch the sunset as you nibble on complementary snacks and sip on your own BYOB beverages. Our underwater light will give you a glimpse of the reef as the daytime creatures tuck away for the night and the nighttime ones begin to wake. This cruise will end with a bang as the sky lights up with fourth of July fireworks over Kailua Bay. Whats Included Snacks, soft drinks, water and ice. BYOB Exclusions: Please no drinking out of glass (glass wine bottles are okay as long as wine is consumed out non-glass container). We suggest you bring your own cooler.
